Container.Name: CrossSync
Container.Overview: Bidirectional P2P sync engine for Unraid shares over Tailscale. TLS 1.3 + certificate-fingerprint device auth; transparent per-file states; conflicts, versioning, event history with manual/auto archive, deletion guard, and page-worthy alerts. Web UI is served by the daemon at http://[IP]:55556/

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the daemon runs as. Unraid default = 99 (nobody). Match this to the owner of your user shares so writes are permitted.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the daemon runs as. Unraid default = 100 (users).

Config.Name: Config path
Config.Description: Bind mount holding config.yaml + meta_dir (per-folder indexes, TLS identity).

Config.Name: User shares
Config.Description: Mount of the user-share root so folders[] paths like /mnt/user/<share> resolve inside the container.
